summary: Phase 7 (Agents / Memory / Security) end-to-end test. Wrote pytest suite (/app/backend/tests/test_phase7_agents_memory_security.py, 5 tests) + Playwright UI walkthrough on the public URL. Found and FIXED a critical FastAPI route-ordering bug that made /agents/team/run unreachable (was shadowed by /agents/{aid}/run which is registered earlier). After the fix, all 5 backend tests pass and the UI Team-run flow works. Memory (semantic search), Agent CRUD + single-run + history, Security overview/audit-logs and admin-only gating all verified.

minor.issue: FIXED — /agents/team/run was being routed to /agents/{aid}/run with aid='team' due to FastAPI matching routes in registration order. Team requests responded 422 'body.input required'. Moved team_run/team_runs registration ABOVE update_agent/delete_agent/run_agent/agent_runs in /app/backend/agents/router.py. Verified via pytest (test_team_run PASS) and curl.

integration_issues.issue: Was silently failing on the UI before fix — no toast shown because Sonner's default error render collapses the FastAPI 422 detail (an array of validation errors). Consider ensuring formatApiErrorDetail() stringifies arrays into user-visible messages so future backend 4xx errors don't disappear.

action_items: Optional (already fixed by testing agent): route ordering in /app/backend/agents/router.py — team_run / team_runs are now registered before /agents/{aid}/... . No further action required.
Optional: improve formatApiErrorDetail() (in AuthContext) to always stringify list-form FastAPI validation errors so team/agent error toasts surface when they occur.
critical_code_review_comments: agents/router.py: The dynamic '/agents/{aid}/...' routes must always be declared AFTER any literal-segment sibling routes ('/agents/team/...'). Added a header comment noting this constraint; consider a router-level test that hits every literal path to guard against regressions.

agents/router.py TeamRunBody uses Field(min_length=1) on agent_ids — good; but the run also accepts up to 20 agents and only executes plan[:4] steps. Consider validating max_length=20 on agent_ids and documenting the '4 subtasks max' limit.

memory/router.py search_memories loads up to 3000 memory docs into memory and does cosine in Python. Fine for tenants <3000 items, but there's no ANN / MongoDB $vectorSearch fallback — flag for scaling.
security/router.py audit_logs endpoint issues an extra users.find_one per audit row (N+1). For limit=200 this is 200 sequential Mongo lookups. Batch with $in or cache the user lookup.
agents/router.py delete_agent uses ObjectId(aid) with no try/except — malformed IDs will 500 instead of 404.

agents/router.py update_agent replaces knowledge on every PATCH (even when the client sends an empty list because the UI dialog doesn't reload existing knowledge). The Agents.js edit form passes knowledge:'' (empty) on edit which will wipe all existing agent knowledge silently. HIGH visibility for end users.

rca of the issue: Bug: /api/orgs/{oid}/agents/team/run returned HTTP 422 'body.input required' (or was silently failing in UI). Root cause: FastAPI matches routes in the order they are declared on the router. router.py declared @router.post('/orgs/{org_id}/agents/{aid}/run') BEFORE @router.post('/orgs/{org_id}/agents/team/run'), so the dynamic '/{aid}/run' route captured aid='team' and rejected the body (RunBody expects 'input', TeamRunBody sends 'goal' + 'agent_ids'). Reproduction: POST {goal, agent_ids:[...]} to /agents/team/run -> 422 with pydantic 'missing body.input'. Fix: moved team_run and team_runs decorators above update_agent/delete_agent/run_agent/agent_runs so the literal '/team/*' paths are registered first. Verified with pytest (5/5 pass) and direct curl (200 OK). Preventive: added a comment in the router file explaining the ordering invariant; future team-mode UI regressions should be caught by test_team_run in the new pytest suite.
